title: All for 1-Bit: Towards Genuine 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.06161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet their massive storage and memory-bandwidth demands still hinder efficient deployment. Weight binarization is a promising solution, but existing binarization-based post-training quantization (PTQ) methods usually far exceed the nominal 1-bit storage target due to hidden overhead. To address this gap, we propose All for 1-Bit (AF1), a genuine 1-bit PTQ framework for LLMs. AF1 comprises two complementary components: (1) Null-space-Aware Binary Factorization (NABF) for improving binary reconstruction through Hessian-aware surrogate reparameterization, null-space-aware binary factorization, and scale-only global reconstruction; and (2) Hierarchical Shapley Allocation (HiSA) for assigning structural capacity using hierarchical Shapley sensitivity. Together, they preserve model accuracy under a strict 1.0-BPW budget in the PTQ setting. Experiments on LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma fa

translated_title: 一切为了1比特：面向大语言模型的真正1比特训练后量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已取得显著进展，但其庞大的存储和内存带宽需求仍阻碍了高效部署。权重二值化是一种有前景的解决方案，但现有的基于二值化的训练后量化（PTQ）方法通常由于隐藏开销而远远超出名义上的1比特存储目标。为解决这一差距，我们提出了All for 1-Bit（AF1），一个面向大语言模型的真正1比特训练后量化框架。AF1包含两个互补的组件：（1）零空间感知二值分解（NABF），通过Hessian感知代理重参数化、零空间感知二值分解和仅缩放的全局重构来改进二值重构；（2）分层Shapley分配（HiSA），利用分层Shapley敏感度来分配结构容量。两者相结合，在PTQ设置下严格1.0-BPW的预算内保持了模型精度。在LLaMA、Qwen和Gemma系列模型上的实验……
tldr: 本文提出AF1框架，通过零空间感知二值分解（NABF）和分层Shapley分配（HiSA）两个互补组件，首次实现了大语言模型在严格1.0-BPW预算下消除隐藏开销的真正1比特训练后量化，同时保持模型精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AF1, a genuine 1-bit post-training quantization framework for LLMs that combines Null-space-Aware Binary Factorization (NABF) and Hierarchical Shapley Allocation (HiSA) to eliminate hidden storage overhead while preserving model accuracy under a strict 1.0-BPW budget.
